description: This file is a shell script that retrieves the partner ID from system configuration sources such as syscfg, dmcli, or device properties, and logs relevant information. It defines functions for logging time-stamped messages and fetching the partner ID with fallbacks if the primary sources are unavailable.

methods.name: echo_time
methods.description: Logs the current timestamp along with a message indicating which script function was called and from where.

methods.name: getPartnerId
methods.description: Retrieves the PartnerID by checking syscfg, then falling back to dmcli, device properties, and defaults to 'comcast' if all else fails.

methods.name: getExperience
methods.description: A placeholder function that currently echoes an empty string; may be intended for future use.
